question: Did the isolated public demo and GET-only paper-account reconciliation complete without activating order submission or modifying pre-existing named resources?
assumptions: The active gcloud identity is authorized for project-757198e6-df23-4e75-b08.
The user authorized new isolated hackathon resources but prohibited changes to pre-existing resources.
HTTP health proves service reachability, not full browser behavior.
Authenticated Alpaca GET responses establish only the account state observed at the receipt timestamp, not future state or profitability.

verification.runner_env: present with root-controlled permissions; values not logged
verification.paper_secret_version_distribution: exactly one enabled version in each of three dedicated containers
verification.broker_get_observation: passed against paper account, positions, and open-orders endpoints

claim_ceiling: C1 deployment mechanics and remote tests; C2 authenticated paper-account state observed at one timestamp; not future readiness, production safety, profitability, or availability guarantee.

Paper-order mode starts before successful reconciliation and explicit acknowledgement.
The deployed source does not match the recorded immutable commit.
Any pre-existing resource is modified outside the named AlphaLedger scope.

cost_risk_budget: One e2-micro and 20GB standard disk in us-central1-a, with a frozen $10 event-period soft budget and no unusual egress.
stop_rule: Stop or disable the isolated resources on cost breach, unexpected exposure, service compromise, account mismatch, secret leakage, live endpoint detection, or any failed runner reconciliation.
